title: Contact router imports undefined ContactRequest/ContactResponse classes
description: backend/app/api/routes/contact.py:2 executes `from app.api.models.plan import ContactRequest, ContactResponse`, but no module in the repository defines classes with those names (verified by repo-wide grep). This raises ImportError as soon as the contact router is imported (main.py:23), a second independent startup-breaking defect alongside the plan.py self-import. Additionally, models/contact.py defines ContactDB which no route ever uses; /api/contact/send, even if importable, is a stub returning a success message without persisting anything - it accepts arbitrary user input and reports success with no side effect (business integrity: users believe their message was sent when nothing is stored or forwarded).
impact: Backend startup failure (with the plan.py fix it would still crash); contact form silently loses user submissions (data-integrity of the contact channel).
mitigation: Define ContactRequest/ContactResponse (e.g., in models/contact.py alongside ContactDB) and either implement real persistence for /api/contact/send or remove the stub endpoint.
